---
title: "D1 Softball Batting Explorer"
format:
  html:
    echo: false
    warning: false
    message: false
---

```{r}
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

fetch_season_batting <- \(season) {
  payload <- list(
    `batting-table` = list(
      callback = "adv_stats",
      args = list(
        object_id = 0,
        post_type = "national",
        season = as.character(season),
        split_type = "overall",
        template = "batting-table"
      )
    )
  )

  resp <- request("https://d1softball.com/wp-json/d1/v1/dynamic-content/") |>
    req_body_json(payload) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_string() |>
    fromJSON()

  read_html(resp$content$`batting-table`) |>
    html_element("#batting-stats") |>
    html_table() |>
    mutate(Season = as.character(season))
}

batting <- map(c(2025, 2026), fetch_season_batting) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  select(Season, Player, Team, Class, POS, BA, OBP, SLG, OPS, GP, PA, AB, H, HR, BB, K) |>
  filter(!is.na(BA), !is.na(OBP), !is.na(SLG))

ojs_define(batting_raw = batting)
```

```{ojs}
players = transpose(batting_raw)

viewof y_metric = Inputs.radio(
  new Map([
    ["On-Base Percentage (OBP)", "OBP"],
    ["Slugging Percentage (SLG)", "SLG"],
    ["Home Runs (HR)", "HR"],
    ["At Bats (AB)", "AB"]
  ]),
  { value: "OBP", label: "Y-Axis Metric:" }
)

viewof season_filter = Inputs.select(
  ["All", "2026", "2025"],
  { value: "All", label: "Season:" }
)

viewof min_pa = Inputs.range(
  [0, 200],
  { value: 50, step: 10, label: "Minimum PA:" }
)

filtered = players.filter(d =>
  (season_filter === "All" || d.Season === season_filter) &&
  d.PA >= min_pa
)
```

**Showing ${filtered.length.toLocaleString()} player-seasons**

```{ojs}
y_labels = ({
  OBP: "On-Base Percentage (OBP)",
  SLG: "Slugging Percentage (SLG)",
  HR: "Home Runs (HR)",
  AB: "At Bats (AB)"
})

Plot.plot({
  width: 800,
  height: 520,
  grid: true,
  x: {
    label: "Batting Average (BA)",
    domain: [0.1, 0.55]
  },
  y: {
    label: y_labels[y_metric],
    nice: true
  },
  color: {
    legend: true,
    label: "Class"
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.dot(filtered, {
      x: "BA",
      y: y_metric,
      stroke: "Class",
      fill: "Class",
      fillOpacity: 0.55,
      r: 3.5,
      tip: true,
      title: d => `${d.Player} (${d.Team}, ${d.Season})\nClass: ${d.Class} | POS: ${d.POS} | PA: ${d.PA} | AB: ${d.AB}\nBA: ${d.BA.toFixed(3)} | OBP: ${d.OBP.toFixed(3)} | SLG: ${d.SLG.toFixed(3)} | HR: ${d.HR}`
    })
  ]
})
```
